LanguageData.LP_AarakocraCaged.stages.0.label: trapped under a roof
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraCaged.stages.0.description: Nothing but rafters overhead, I can't even spread my wings. I want to see the sky.
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraOpenSky.stages.0.label: sky above
LanguageData.LP_AarakocraOpenSky.stages.0.description: The sky is right above me and the wind runs through my feathers. Work feels easy.
That elf loves heights and wind too. We often chat in the treetops.
That aarakocra's feathers are the color of the forest, and it talks like birdsong.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_AarakocraMindFlayer.st: That mind flayer crawled up from depths that never see the sun. Just thinking of it makes my feathers stand on end.
